families.reason: Protected professor actions and student review completion require role/capability enforcement.
The issue explicitly requires isolation by user and contractId, including one account across contracts.
Student/professor HTTP-visible states and provider failure semantics must not leak protected details.
The CTA and completion flow must continue operating on the correct live pending review through later steps.
External delivery acceptance/failure and review persistence have ordered states that must remain truthful.
No requirement selects a future destination or period from competing date fields.
Repeated review requests must not create duplicate pending authorities under concurrency.
Repeated manual requests must reuse/deduplicate the pending review according to the #344 rule.
External provider failure must not roll back the already valid review and internal notification.
Review audit/history and approval/rejection transitions must remain traceable instead of being overwritten.
The flow must reuse canonical backend/provider boundaries and real internal contracts rather than parallel rules.
The issue explicitly requires canonical product, architecture, deployment and student contract coherence.
